mechanism: Verapamil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing perphenazine metabolism and increasing its plasma concentration, while both drugs have additive negative inotropic and hypotensive effects.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostatic hypotension, arrhythmias); consider dose reduction of perphenazine or use alternative antipsychotic with less cardiac effects.
